reviews.review:
mfw i risk a large sum of rain

fair warning redditors, this game is very hard!

Man, I'm really torn on this. I liked Risk of Rain 2 even though it's balls-to-the-wall hard a lot of times. And I never owned nor played Risk of Rain 1.

So, I picked it up on a whim and I just can't seem to get into it. I'm hating every moment of the game.
From the terrible design choices of Clicking to change options. Like, if your resolution is wrong, you have to click until you FIND the one you want. It's the same deal for changing any Music or SFX. You click until you hit the number you want it at. What a nonsense way to do something that has been fine for years. Drop down menus are pretty basic and a slider bar for sounds is easy.

To the controls with a Controller that are basically xInput like and don't snap the mouse to menu options. I feel like Big Picture Mode could've done a better job than what they got going here and that's just Auto mode.

The base sound effects are ear bleedingly loud when compared to the music. I couldn't believe it.

Then there is the sheer size of everything and not remembering/knowing what items are that I'm paying for. Not sure why it doesn't tell me what X is and what it does but okay then.

I hate the controls cause I find the button placement bad and I didn't enjoy my roll button being smack dab in the middle of useful attack buttons. I would've prefered if I could change the skill locations instead of changing every button.

Yeah, yeah, hard game, get gud, blah blah. I don't know why it has a game mode where none of your progress is saved? Feels like a punishment to just have fun not dying.

I didn't really like the tiny ass pixel art but a good game with fun gameplay doesn't need good graphics. I've learned this from other games over the years.

I know, I'm being a whiny little ♥♥♥♥♥ and I'm sure the Risk Of Rain Returns version might solve everything I dislike about this one so, I'll hold on for that one instead.
I almost forgot how fast this game is.
